funder_origin_name: Wolf Foundation (endowment donated by Ricardo Subirana y Lobo Wolf and Francisca Wolf)
funding_share_basis: The purse is paid entirely (100%) out of the Wolf Foundation's own endowment, established in 1975-76 with a USD 10 million gift from Ricardo Wolf and his wife Francisca; no other funder contributes to the prize money. The Israeli state supplies no purse money: its role is statutory and supervisory only (the Foundation operates under the Wolf Foundation Law-1975, the Minister of Education chairs the Foundation Council, and the State Comptroller audits the Foundation), and trustees, council, juries and auditor serve on a voluntary basis.
money_note: Each Wolf Prize, including Chemistry, carries USD 100,000 plus a diploma and Medal of Honor, paid from the Wolf Foundation endowment; the prize has been awarded since 1978 and the amount is shared when there are co-laureates.
evidence_quote: Founded in 1975 with an endowment from the Wolf family, the Foundation's major donors were Dr. Ricardo Subirana Y Lobo Wolf and his wife, Francisca.
judgment_reason: A coder could plausibly call the Wolf Foundation Government, since it was constituted by an act of the Knesset (Wolf Foundation Law-1975), its Council is chaired ex officio by Israel's Minister of Education, and the State Comptroller audits it. We code Philanthropy because the corpus is a private family endowment and no public appropriation pays the purse; the statutory framework governs oversight, not financing.
